headline: Colombia low-value e-commerce imports jump 500% as buyers avoid VAT threshold
summary: Shipping documentation reveals cross-border de minimis shipments from e-commerce platforms such as Temu into Colombia have grown 500% since 2023 to avoid the $200 threshold for value-added tax.
why: De minimis tax exemptions on cross-border parcel deliveries directly affect local retail tax collection and domestic merchant competitiveness.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: A 500% spike in de minimis import shipments reduces domestic sales tax collection.
